name: Drink
description: The NPC drinks one alcoholic drink (ale, mead, wine and the like): their own if they carry one, else a bottle standing nearby. Use it whenever the NPC says they will have a drink now, for example when offered one or when they suggest sharing one.
note: Living World only (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). The NPC drinks from their inventory first, else picks up a bottle within a few steps; with neither, the game says so and the NPC can order from the bar instead. Each drink is remembered and makes the NPC merrier, then tipsy, then drunk, in speech and mood only.
prompt: If you have a drink of ale, mead or wine now (you decide to, accept one, or say you will), begin your response with '{key}:'. Never say you are having a drink without it.
